title: ELEPHANT 100 mandatory time chart 2026
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: The official time chart lists 11 rows: the start at Wat Nhong Bua Noi, nine aid stations and the finish at Chiang Mai PAO Park.
The chart gives cumulative distances of 0, 9, 20, 28, 38, 43, 58, 67, 77 and 90 km at the start and through the aid stations, and 101 km at the finish.
The chart gives station altitudes from 710 m at the start to 1,370 m at A15, and 320 m at the finish.
The chart gives cumulative ascent of 5,540 m and cumulative descent of 5,540 m at the finish.

The chart shows cut-off times at five points only: A10 16:00 on 4 December, A11 19:30 on 4 December, A13 01:30 on 5 December, A16 09:30 on 5 December and the finish 12:00 on 5 December; the start, A18, A9, A12, A14 and A15 show no cut-off time.
The chart's 'slowest' reference time for A16 is 09:43 on 5 December, 13 minutes later than the 09:30 cut-off printed on the same row.
The chart gives a start time of 08:00 and a finish at 12:00 the next day, consistent with the published 28-hour limit.
